about: The map's background (streets, water, parks, labels), copied once a week into a small local file so the map never waits on an outside tile server. jobs/build_basemap.py cuts it from the Protomaps daily build of OpenStreetMap.
license: Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL); this file is a Produced Work and needs the attribution below. Tile schema and style: Protomaps (BSD-3-Clause, style CC0). Fonts: Noto Sans (SIL Open Font License). Icons: Mapzen/tangrams (MIT).

areas.what: Chicago and nearby suburbs, for the zoomed-out view
